name: Reception team
seniority: Guest support listed around the clock
description: The reception team helps with booking requests, arrival questions, check-in, check-out and practical stay details.
tips: Call before arrival to confirm availability, room category and any late check-in details.
body: This public team profile keeps the site focused on real hotel service without inventing individual staff names.
Reception is the best contact point for current rates, parking questions, room setup and arrival timing.

name: Housekeeping team
description: Housekeeping supports the clean and practical stay experience described across public listings and review patterns.
tips: Ask reception if you need housekeeping timing adjusted during your stay.
body: Clean, well-prepared rooms are a key part of the Passage Hotel positioning.
This profile describes the team function rather than naming unverified individual employees.

name: Guest service team
description: The guest service team coordinates everyday questions about rooms, parking, Wi-Fi, luggage and local directions.
tips: For exact prices, pets, meals or optional services, ask the team directly before publishing or booking.
body: Some public aggregators list optional services that should be confirmed before being presented as official hotel guarantees.
The guest service team is the right contact for clarifying what is available on the current date.
